import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    # Fix species label variants by converting to title case
    df = df.copy()
    df['species'] = df['species'].str.capitalize()
    
    # Remove negative flipper length
    df = df[df['flipper_length_mm'] >= 0]
    
    # Convert body_mass_g from text to number (remove commas)
    df['body_mass_g'] = df['body_mass_g'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '').astype(float)
    
    # Remove duplicate rows
    df = df.drop_duplicates().reset_index(drop=True)
    
    return df

def answer(df):
    result = df.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean().round(2).to_dict()
    return result
